items.title: Titan's June quarter profit surges 63% YoY, income up 40%
items.description: Titan Company has shown impressive growth, reporting a staggering 63% increase in profit, largely driven by a surge in demand for jewellery during the Akshaya Tritiya festival. The consolidated income jumped by 40%, reaching around Rs 20,753 crore. Notably, jewellery sales, excluding bullion, rose by 43% to Rs 18,253 crore, while the watches and EyeCare segments also saw significant revenue boosts.

items.title: Ola Electric's Q1 revenue drops 45% YoY but loss narrows to Rs 336 crore
items.description: Ola Electric faced a significant downturn in its June quarter operations, reporting a steep forty-five percent decline in revenue compared to last year. The company earned four hundred fifty-five crore rupees in the first quarter, with vehicle registrations also dropping as compared to the previous year. Despite this, Ola's net loss displayed a slight improvement, narrowing by about twenty-one point five percent year-on-year, with overall unit deliveries also decreasing.

items.title: Hindalco posts record Q1 profit of Rs 7,013 crore as aluminium prices soar
items.description: Hindalco Industries achieved record-breaking profit and sales in the June quarter, largely due to a surge of nearly fifty percent in aluminum prices. Their US subsidiary, Novelis, played a key role in this financial success. Moving forward, Hindalco plans to focus on executing various projects, including refineries, smelters, and recycling plants, as part of their strategy for future growth.

items.title: SBI's Q1 profit jumps 10% YoY on loan growth, beats Street estimates
items.description: State Bank of India announced a notable ten percent growth in net profit for the June quarter, driven by robust loan growth that amplified its operating income. The year-on-year increase of fifteen percent in net interest income signifies healthy core earnings from its lending activities. Additionally, the bank aims to raise ten billion dollars through specialized FCNR(B) deposit schemes.
